x.description: Input tensor of shape `(..., M, M)`.
constraints: x must be a 3-D or higher dimensional tensor with an even number of dimensions.

upper.description: If True, returns the upper-triangular Cholesky factor. If False (default), returns the lower-triangular Cholesky factor.

output.description: A tensor of shape `(..., M, M)` representing the Cholesky factor of `x`.
